lessonTitle: Acts Chapter 19 — Paul in Ephesus / The Riot

questions.questionText: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul took the road through the interior and arrived at where?
There he found some disciples and asked if they received the Holy Spirit. What did they say?
options: No, we have not even heard that there is a Holy Spirit

questions.questionText: Paul asked, Then what baptism did you receive? They said?
On hearing this they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus. About how many men were there?
When Paul placed his hands on them, what happened?
options: The Holy Spirit came on them, and they spoke in tongues and prophesied

questions.questionText: Paul entered the synagogue and spoke boldly for how many months?
When some became obstinate, Paul left and had discussions daily in the lecture hall of whom?
This went on for how many years so that all the Jews and Greeks in the province of Asia heard the word?
God did extraordinary miracles through Paul. Even what were taken to the sick?
options: Handkerchiefs and aprons that had touched him

questions.questionText: I am a Jewish chief priest. My seven sons tried to drive out evil spirits using Jesus’ name. Who am I?
The evil spirit answered, Jesus I know, and Paul I know about, but who are you? Then what?
options: The man gave them a beating and they ran out naked and bleeding

questions.questionText: This became known to the Jews and Greeks living in where?
Many who believed came and openly confessed. A number who had practiced sorcery did what?
options: Brought their scrolls together and burned them publicly

questions.questionText: When they calculated the value of the scrolls, it came to how many drachmas?
In this way the word of the Lord spread widely and grew in what?
Paul decided to go to Jerusalem, passing through Macedonia and Achaia. After that he must visit where?
He sent two of his helpers to Macedonia. Who were they?
I am a silversmith who made silver shrines of Artemis. Who am I?
Demetrius said Paul is saying that gods made by human hands are no gods at all. What might happen to their trade?
options: They would lose their good name and the temple of Artemis would be discredited

questions.questionText: When they heard this they were furious and began shouting what?
options: Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!

questions.questionText: The city was in an uproar. People seized Gaius and Aristarchus and rushed into where?
Paul wanted to appear before the crowd, but whom would not let him?
Even some of the officials of the province, friends of Paul, begged him not to do what?
True or false: The assembly was in confusion; most of the people did not even know why they were there.
The Jews pushed me to the front. I motioned for silence but they shouted me down. Who am I?
They all shouted in unison for about how long: Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!?
Who quieted the crowd and said Ephesus is the guardian of the temple of the great Artemis?
The clerk said if Demetrius has a grievance they can do what?
options: Bring charges. This gathering risks being charged with rioting

questions.questionText: After he had said this, he dismissed the what?
I am Paul’s traveling companion from Macedonia seized with Gaius. Who am I?
Paul stayed in Ephesus a little longer after planning to go through Macedonia. Where did he remain while sending helpers?
True or false: Illnesses left the sick and evil spirits went out when cloths that touched Paul were used.
I am Artemis, and Demetrius said the world worships me. Who is this goddess of?
Paul had discussions daily in whose lecture hall?
True or false: All the Jews and Greeks who lived in the province of Asia heard the word of the Lord.
options: True — but they all rejected it

questions.questionText: Who tried to invoke the name of the Lord Jesus over those who were demon-possessed?
options: Some Jews who went around driving out evil spirits

questions.questionText: The evil spirit said, Jesus I know, and Paul I know about, but who are _____?
Fear seized them all and the name of the Lord Jesus was what?
I am one of Paul’s helpers sent to Macedonia with Timothy. Who am I?
True or false: There arose a great disturbance about the Way.
About how many men were in the group of disciples Paul found at Ephesus who had received John’s baptism?
When Paul laid hands on them, they spoke in tongues and what else?
Paul spoke boldly in the synagogue for how many months?
After leaving the synagogue, Paul had discussions daily in the lecture hall of whom?
This went on for two years, so that all the Jews and Greeks who lived in the province of Asia heard the word of the Lord. Where was Paul?
Who made silver shrines of Artemis and started a riot?
The city clerk said the rioters were in danger of being charged with what?
